title: Why Dealerships Push Extended Warranties: Profit Margin Analysis
summary: An article aimed at dealers lays out the full profit structure behind vehicle service contracts, from dealer markup through administrator and reinsurance layers.

assertions.quote: dealers may apply markups ranging from 50% to 200% above wholesale cost
administrators retain 24-50% of every premium dollar after paying claims
Loss aversion -- the principle that people feel potential losses more acutely than equivalent gains
F&I products now represent approximately 25% of total dealership gross profit, up from just 15% in 2009
